title: Backups
subtitle: Encrypted archives of BIND, Kea and Pelagos, copied off the node, and restore

errors.host: A host name or an address
errors.sftpPath: A folder without quotes, globs or tabs
errors.privateKey: An unencrypted private key (BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY)
errors.keyAgain: The server changed: enter the key again

test.ok: Probe file written, read back and deleted.
test.help: Writes, reads back and deletes a small file from this node.

dest.title: Destinations

help.peer: Each node sends its archives to the other nodes over the cluster's mutual TLS. Covers the loss of a node, not of the site.
help.mounted: A folder you mount yourself (NFS, SMB through fstab or a systemd automount). Pelagos mounts nothing and keeps no SMB password.
help.sftp: An SFTP server reached with a dedicated key and its pinned host key. Restrict the key on the server (ForceCommand internal-sftp, chroot).

dest.name: Name
dest.mountedHelp: Must be a mount point and writable on every node that uses it.
dest.sshKeyStored: Private key (stored: type a new one to replace it)
dest.sshKeyHelp: Sealed by the cluster master key and never shown again.
dest.customKeepHelp: Otherwise the retention of the settings below.
dest.localHelp: Each node also keeps its newest archives in /var/lib/pelagos/archives/local.
dest.empty: No destination: archives stay on each node only.
dest.deleteBody: Archives already copied there stay where they are; Pelagos stops writing and pruning there.

key.title: Archive key
key.generateHelp: Every archive is encrypted to this key. Its identity is shown once: keep it outside the cluster. Confirm with your password.
key.rotateHelp: New archives use a new key. The former identity stays on the nodes while an archive still needs it. Confirm with your password.
key.none: No archive key: no archive can be written and scheduling stays off. Generate the cluster key.
key.storedYes: Kept by the cluster (sealed by the master key)
key.help: Archives hold master.key and the CA key: they are always encrypted, to the cluster key and to the operator keys below.
key.retired_one: {{count}} former identity kept for older archives
key.retired_other: {{count}} former identities kept for older archives
key.operatorsHelp: age public keys whose identity you keep offline: an archive then opens without the cluster too.
key.label: Label
key.removeBody: New archives will no longer be encrypted to {{label}}. Existing archives are unchanged.
key.onceWarning: Shown once. Without it, losing the whole cluster makes every archive unrecoverable. Store it offline.
key.savedAck: I stored this identity outside the cluster.

settings.title: Schedule and retention
settings.scheduleHelp: Each node archives at the start time, shifted by its rank, then at every interval.
settings.help: Alert thresholds (stale archive, failures) are in Administration, Settings.

upload.title: Upload an archive
upload.help: A .tar.gz.age file made by Pelagos elsewhere. It is opened to read its manifest, then kept on this node for a restore.
upload.identity: Identity that opens it (if not the cluster's)

restore.title: Restore from {{node}}, {{when}}
restore.movedHelp: Another node than {{node}}: its names and addresses in the configurations must be replaced before applying.
restore.identityHelp: Only for an archive the cluster's identities do not open (an operator key). Never stored.
restore.substituteHelp: Applied as whole words to the BIND files and every Kea string.
restore.haPlain: Kea HA without TLS for now (the target has no HA certificates yet; run the Kea HA TLS plan afterwards)
restore.incomplete: Some files could not be read when it was made.
restore.userFiles: Also restore named.conf and the files it includes (Pelagos never rewrites them otherwise).
restore.userFilesAck: I checked their difference and confirm the overwrite.
